skill.summary: End-to-end coach for dropshipping operators (general store / niche store / one-product / branded private-label) using Shopify, AliExpress / CJDropshipping /...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of dropshipping-coach skill with comprehensive, end-to-end guidance for modern dropshipping operators across Shopify, TikTok Shop, Amazon FBM, Etsy, Walmart, and eBay.
- Covers critical topics: niche/product selection, supplier vetting, ad strategies (TikTok, Meta, Google, etc.), unit economics, customs and duties, refunds/chargebacks, store conversion, scaling, and pivoting to private label.
- Integrates up-to-date insights on 2026 realities: changes to US Section 321/de minimis import rules, TikTok Shop dominance, and shifts in social ad creative lifecycle.
- Diagnostic process included: operators receive structured questioning on niche, product, supplier, fulfillment, traffic sources, and operational setup before actionable advice.
- Clear exclusions: no support for counterfeit products, IP infringement, MLM mentorship scams, or blackhat tactics.
